data.name: Sachin
data.gender_notes: Sachin is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sat, 'truth, being' — sachin, 'pure, true'. Its root is Sanskrit sat (सत्). A classical Sanskrit name. Sachin is a Sanskrit name meaning “Pure; true; essence”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sachin expresses “Pure; true; essence”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit sat, 'truth, being' — sachin, 'pure, true'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sachin total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_english.name: Sachin
in_english.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sat, 'truth, being' — sachin, 'pure, true'. Its root is Sanskrit sat (सत्). A classical Sanskrit name. Sachin is a Sanskrit name meaning “Pure; true; essence”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Sachin is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Pure; true; essence”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Sachin is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Pure; true; essence” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Sachin; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: In Hinduism, 'Sachin' is the name of a legendary king and a popular god. It is also mentioned in various Vedic texts, including the Rigveda (1.17.12).

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Sachin.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
